description: MuScriptor is an audio-to-symbolic model that converts music audio into symbolic note events or MIDI files, with instrument constraints, sampling, beam search, batch chunk decoding, and streaming final-result output.

request.name: instruments
request.description: Comma-separated instrument group names to constrain generated MIDI events; empty allows all instruments.

request.name: output_format
request.description: Primary output serialization written by --out; midi writes a MIDI file, json writes generated note events. Default midi.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated MIDI-event token count per chunk; default 2000.

request.name: do_sample
request.description: Use temperature sampling instead of greedy token selection; default false.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Sampling temperature when do_sample=true; 0 is accepted for compatibility and behaves deterministically, default 1.0.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Classifier-free guidance coefficient; 1 disables CFG, default 1.0.

request.name: batch_size
request.description: Number of audio chunks processed per batch when prelude_forcing=false; default 1.

request.name: num_beams
request.description: Beam-search width; 1 disables beam search, default 1.

request.name: prelude_forcing
request.description: Force open-note prelude tokens between sequential chunks; default true.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Transformer weight storage type; default native.

session.name: perf_mode
session.description: Decoder attention mode; flash_attention uses the CUDA fast path, off keeps the exact attention path. Default flash_attention.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Weight context arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: conditioning_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Condition graph arena size in MiB; default 128.

session.name: decoder_prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Decoder prefill graph arena size in MiB; default 768.

session.name: decoder_decode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Decoder cached-step graph arena size in MiB; default 512.
